reply.text: Fifteen pounds in a week isn't a real target — that's water and stress, not fat, and chasing it hard before a wedding is a good way to feel like garbage on the day you most want to feel good. I won't hand you a crash plan. If you want, I can point you to where the app sets up targets based on your weight and activity, or we can talk training that leaves you looking and feeling sharp without wrecking you first.
